title: Native GPU wrapper cannot pass a literal-dollar duplicate CTest exclusion through cmd.exe
body: The queued native look-dev command with tools/run-native-gpu-suite.bat -R Application.LookdevCapture -LE ^"^$" failed before CTest with cmd.exe syntax error ($" -j 1 ... was unexpected). The native wrapper needs an exclusion override to include native-labeled look-dev cases, but its cmd escaping does not preserve this regex. Workaround: pass a no-match exclusion token (-LE nomatch), which preserves the intended selection without cmd metacharacters; consolidate safe native CTest argument transport.

title: Pin-chain helper should derive exact provider SHAs instead of hand-edited values
body: The vx8 native boot stopped in prepare because UndersetLauncher toolchain/providers/kfr.pin recorded mistyped SHA 7edf953b25d25abddce0c81ad3d97fe53d4dbf15 instead of the actual KFR commit 7edf953fd2f393779c5ff08ce557d9a3bce7104a; the correction required new launcher and Undertow pin commits before boot could proceed. Suggested consolidation: make the pin-chain helper derive git rev-parse SHAs and validate every downstream pin before invoking native boot.
